## What is it?

[SciSure](https://support.elabnext.com/hc/en-us/categories/36665746497940-Product-Documentation) is an application that supports researchers with documenting experiments and results in a digital journal, inventory and protocols.
The SciSure platform is hosted by [SciSure](https://www.scisure.com/). 

SciSure is used by three faculties at VU Amsterdam: BETA, FGB and ACTA. If you are interested in using SciSure, but it is not yet available in your department, please contact your VU organisational admin to discuss the possibilities.

## What can it be used for?

SciSure is used as a [digital lab journal](https://support.elabnext.com/hc/en-us/sections/36677070274324-Journal) where you can track your results and share data recorded in experiments in the electronic lab notebook.

Experiments are organised by projects; each project can contain multiple studies. SciSure can also be used to document your [inventory](https://support.elabnext.com/hc/en-us/sections/36677070246804-Inventory), e.g. samples.

Next to this, SciSure can be used to create and share [protocols](https://support.elabnext.com/hc/en-us/sections/36677103239188-Protocols) and to register and book equipment.
